from.place: The resolution-section comparison: normalized Hom cocycles, their restriction, and their augmentation-preserving pullback transfer, below the Mayer-Vietoris comparison. Substep: whole-to-open restriction of normalized comparisons.

title: Whole to open restriction of canonical resolution comparison
statement: Let X be a scheme, G an abelian sheaf on its small etale site, I an injective resolution of G, and c a resolution-section comparison normalized on Hom cocycles [def-weil-pbc-etale-resolution-section-canonical-comparison]. For every open W of X, natural-number degree q, and class x in H^q(I(X)), applying c.openEquiv W q after homology of section restriction X to W equals cohomologyMap W.ι G q applied after c.globalEquiv q [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback].

proof.text: Proof: Let K be the resolution evaluated at the terminal etale object. Since K.homologyπ q is an epimorphism of abelian groups, write the given class as the image of a cycle z. The constant-sheaf adjunction identifies K.iCycles q z with a unique morphism f from the constant lifted integers to I.cocomplex.X q. Naturality in the coefficient sheaf identifies its composite with the differential with the differential of the section, which is zero; thus f is a Hom cocycle. Let a be the free-sheaf map from the free sheaf on W to the constant integer sheaf corresponding to the constant section 1 on W. The free-sheaf sections adjunction identifies a composed with f with the restriction of the original section. Naturality of homologyπ identifies its cycle class with the homology map of etaleSectionMap. Apply c.global_cocycle and c.open_cocycle to the two cycles. The formula I.mk₀_comp_extMk identifies the second Ext class with precomposition of the first by a. In etaleOpenObjectCohomologyMap, pulling back a and precomposing with etaleOpenFreeSheafUnit W is the inverse of the constant-sheaf comparison: both maps classify the section 1 by the constant sheaf adjunction. Functoriality of Ext under the exact inverse-image functor and associativity of Ext composition now give cohomologyMap W.ι on the first class. Surjectivity of homologyπ gives the equality for every class. The argument uses no positive-degree or nonempty-open assumption, so includes q = 0, the empty open, identity restriction and the zero sheaf.

lean.statement: theorem resolutionSection_canonical_whole_to_open {X : Scheme.{u}} (G : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (I : InjectiveResolution G) (c : ResolutionSectionCanonicalComparison G I) : ∀ W q x, c.openEquiv W q (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (etaleSectionMap (MorphismProperty.Over.homMk W.ι (Category.comp_id _) : Scheme.Etale.mk W.ι ⟶ Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 X)) I.cocomplex) q x) = cohomologyMap W.ι G q (c.globalEquiv q x)
